API ReferenceZscaler Client Connector APIPublic API ControllerRetrieves the list of application profile policies
Retrieves the list of application profile policies
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/application-profiles

Retrieves the list of application profile policies.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 50.

search
string

The search string used to match against the policies.

searchType
string

The search string used to match against the search type. This is enabled only for filename, name, policyToken, ruleset, or groups.

deviceType
int32

The search string used to match against the device type.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
429

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
policies
object[]
totalCount
int64

Specifies the total number of policies in the database related to search criteria.
